name: dart-plugin
description: Plain Dart backend stack provider for the SDLC marketplace (priority=100). Detects any pubspec.yaml project and registers a dart-architect agent (Sonnet/medium) as the development-phase backend implementer. Handles CLI tools, pub packages, and servers (shelf, dart_frog, serverpod-free plain HTTP). Flutter projects are claimed by flutter-plugin (priority 300, backend + frontend), so dart-plugin stays inactive there. Reuses shared skills from dart-foundation (dart-conventions, dart-tooling, dart-testing).
